title: Designer
subtitle: 「設計師／設計者／創作者」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中自然的替代表達？
description: 「設計師／設計者／創作者」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中自然的替代表達？

words.note: 當 designer 的重點是「創造某個作品、產品或概念的人」時很自然。
words.example: The creator of the logo wanted it to look simple and memorable.
words.exampleZh: 這個標誌的創作者希望它看起來簡潔而容易記住。

exercises.original: The designer of the new logo wanted it to be simple and memorable.
exercises.zh: 新標誌的創作者希望它簡潔而容易記住。
exercises.upgrade: The creator of the new logo wanted it to be simple and memorable.

options.explanation: 這裡重點是誰創造了 logo，因此 creator 很自然。
可能畫了圖，但 logo designer 不一定是 illustrator。
可能負責整體方向，不一定親自創作 logo。
通常負責實作或技術開發。
強調規劃，不如 creator 表達創作本身。

exercises.original: The designer of the chair said comfort was the main priority.
exercises.zh: 這張椅子的創作者表示舒適度是首要考慮。
exercises.upgrade: The creator of the chair said comfort was the main priority.

options.explanation: 泛指設計並創造這件產品的人。
如果此人親自製造椅子也可能成立，但題句只說 designer。
不是家具設計的一般同義詞。

exercises.original: The exhibition celebrates the designers behind several iconic products.
exercises.zh: 展覽表揚多件經典產品背後的創作者。
exercises.upgrade: The exhibition celebrates the creators behind several iconic products.

options.explanation: 產品「背後的創作者」是自然概括。
產品開發者可能參與，但不等同設計者。

words.note: 正式、概括地指從事設計工作的專業人士。
words.example: The company consulted several design professionals before changing the product.
words.exampleZh: 公司在更改產品前諮詢了數名設計專業人士。

exercises.original: The company consulted several designers before changing the packaging.
exercises.zh: 公司在更改包裝前諮詢了數名設計專業人士。
exercises.upgrade: The company consulted several design professionals before changing the packaging.

options.explanation: 正式、概括地指專業設計人士。
太廣，未必有專業設計背景。
藝術家不一定從事商業包裝設計。

exercises.original: Experienced designers were invited to review the new product concept.
exercises.zh: 經驗豐富的設計專業人士獲邀審核新產品概念。
exercises.upgrade: Experienced design professionals were invited to review the concept.

options.explanation: 強調製作，不一定具有設計專業。
規劃只是設計的一部分。
可參與產品開發，但不是 designer 的同義詞。

exercises.original: The conference brings together designers from many industries.
exercises.zh: 會議集合來自多個產業的設計專業人士。
exercises.upgrade: The conference brings together design professionals from many industries.

options.explanation: 跨產業時比某個特定 designer 類別更適合。

words.meaning: 設計專家；設計專業人員
words.note: 表示在某一設計領域具有專業知識的人。
words.example: A design specialist reviewed the layout before publication.
words.exampleZh: 出版前，一名設計專家審核了版面。

exercises.original: A designer with specialist knowledge reviewed the page layout.
exercises.zh: 一名具專門知識的設計專家審核了頁面版面。
exercises.upgrade: A design specialist reviewed the page layout.

options.explanation: 句子明確強調 specialist knowledge。
只是創作者，未突出專業知識。

exercises.original: The company hired a designer who specializes in accessible interfaces.
exercises.zh: 公司聘請了一名專長無障礙介面的設計專家。
exercises.upgrade: The company hired a design specialist in accessible interfaces.

options.explanation: 不一定處理介面可用性。
負責程式，不是設計同義詞。

exercises.original: The designer was brought in because the project required advanced packaging expertise.
exercises.zh: 由於項目需要高階包裝設計專業知識，因此請來一名設計專家。
exercises.upgrade: A design specialist was brought in for the project.

options.explanation: advanced expertise 是最直接線索。
不一定有包裝設計專長。

words.note: 當 designer 主要負責畫面、版面、色彩、介面等視覺元素時很自然。
words.example: The visual designer refined the colour palette and page layout.
words.exampleZh: 視覺設計師調整了配色和頁面版面。

exercises.original: The designer adjusted the colour palette, typography, and page layout.
exercises.zh: 設計師調整配色、字體和頁面版面。
exercises.upgrade: The visual designer adjusted the colour palette, typography, and page layout.

options.explanation: 這些都是視覺設計核心工作。

exercises.original: The app designer was responsible mainly for colours, icons, and visual consistency.
exercises.zh: 這名應用程式設計師主要負責顏色、圖示和視覺一致性。
exercises.upgrade: The app's visual designer was responsible for colours, icons, and visual consistency.

options.explanation: 工作範圍清楚集中在視覺元素。
是視覺化概念／成果，不是人。

exercises.original: A designer created the visual system used across the website.
exercises.zh: 一名視覺設計師建立了網站使用的整套視覺系統。
exercises.upgrade: A visual designer created the visual system used across the website.

options.explanation: 可能製作插圖，但不一定建立完整視覺系統。
形容詞／名詞，不是標準人物稱呼。

words.note: 較廣義地指從事創意工作的專業人士。
words.example: The project brought together writers, designers, and other creative professionals.
words.exampleZh: 這個項目集合了作家、設計師和其他創意專業人士。

exercises.original: The project employed designers, writers, photographers, and other creative workers.
exercises.zh: 項目聘用了設計師、作家、攝影師和其他創意專業人士。
exercises.upgrade: The project employed designers, writers, photographers, and other creative professionals.

options.explanation: 能自然包含多類創意職業。
太窄，不能包括所有 writers / photographers。

exercises.original: As a designer, she works in a field shared by many kinds of creative people.
exercises.zh: 作為設計師，她屬於一個包含多種創意工作者的專業領域。
exercises.upgrade: As a designer, she is a creative professional.

options.explanation: designer 是 broader category creative professional 的一種。

exercises.original: The studio provides workspace for designers and other people in creative occupations.
exercises.zh: 工作室為設計師及其他創意專業人士提供工作空間。
exercises.upgrade: The studio provides workspace for creative professionals.

options.explanation: 最自然概括不同 creative occupations。

words.note: 在廣告、設計、媒體等行業中，creative 可作名詞指創意人員。
words.example: The agency hired two new creatives for the campaign.
words.exampleZh: 代理公司為這次宣傳活動聘請了兩名新的創意人員。

exercises.original: The advertising agency hired two new designers for the campaign team.
exercises.zh: 廣告公司為宣傳團隊聘請了兩名新的創意人員。
exercises.upgrade: The advertising agency hired two new creatives.

options.explanation: 廣告／設計行業中可作名詞指創意人員。
也可泛指創作者，但不是 agency 行業稱呼的同樣語感。
廣告公司也有 planners，但角色不同。

exercises.original: The studio has a team of designers and other creative staff.
exercises.zh: 工作室有一支由設計師和其他創意人員組成的團隊。
exercises.upgrade: The studio has a team of creatives.

options.explanation: 行業口語可泛指不同創意職能的人。
未必是設計／媒體創意人員。

exercises.original: Several designers presented ideas during the agency's brainstorming session.
exercises.zh: 幾名創意人員在代理公司的腦力激盪會議中提出想法。
exercises.upgrade: Several creatives presented ideas during the agency's brainstorming session.

options.explanation: agency + brainstorming 是常見行業用法。
可能出席，但不是 designer 的替代。
單數可作名詞，但 several 需要複數 creatives。

words.note: 當 designer 強調先構思、安排結構或制定方案時可接近。
words.example: The planner developed a detailed layout for the exhibition space.
words.exampleZh: 規劃者為展覽空間制定了詳細配置方案。

exercises.original: The exhibition designer developed a detailed layout for the space.
exercises.zh: 展覽規劃者為空間制定了詳細配置。
exercises.upgrade: The exhibition planner developed a detailed layout for the space.

options.explanation: 當重點是空間安排與方案規劃時很自然。

exercises.original: The designer worked out how each room would be used before construction began.
exercises.zh: 設計者在施工前規劃每個房間的用途。
exercises.upgrade: The planner worked out how each room would be used.

options.explanation: worked out how each room would be used 強調規劃。

exercises.original: The event designer mapped out the visitor experience from entrance to exit.
exercises.zh: 活動規劃者由入口到出口規劃整個訪客體驗。
exercises.upgrade: The event planner mapped out the visitor experience.

options.explanation: mapped out 是明顯規劃語境。

words.note: 當 designer 同時親自製作或創造物件時可接近。
words.example: The furniture maker designed and built each chair by hand.
words.exampleZh: 這位家具製作者親自設計並手工製作每張椅子。

exercises.original: The furniture designer also built every chair by hand.
exercises.zh: 這位家具製作者也親手製作每張椅子。
exercises.upgrade: The furniture maker also built every chair by hand.

options.explanation: built ... by hand 明確突出製作角色。

exercises.original: The designer creates and produces handmade lamps in a small workshop.
exercises.zh: 這位製作者在小型工作室設計並製作手工燈具。
exercises.upgrade: The maker creates and produces handmade lamps in a small workshop.

options.explanation: 設計＋親自製作物件，非常適合 maker。
主要處理視覺元素，不一定製作燈具。

exercises.original: The designer behind the ceramic collection shapes and fires the pieces personally.
exercises.zh: 這套陶瓷作品的製作者親自塑形和燒製作品。
exercises.upgrade: The maker behind the ceramic collection shapes and fires the pieces personally.

options.explanation: 親自製作是決定性線索。
也接近，但沒有 maker 那麼強調手工製作。
動詞／名詞，不是人物名詞。

words.note: 表示最先提出或創造某個設計、概念或方案的人。
words.example: She was the originator of the original packaging concept.
words.exampleZh: 她是最初包裝概念的構思者。

exercises.original: The designer who first developed the packaging concept later left the company.
exercises.zh: 最初提出包裝概念的構思者後來離開公司。
exercises.upgrade: The originator of the packaging concept later left the company.

options.explanation: first developed the concept 明確指最初構思者。
可能參與規劃，但不一定是最初提出者。

exercises.original: She was the designer who first proposed the now-famous chair concept.
exercises.zh: 她是最初提出這款著名椅子概念的人。
exercises.upgrade: She was the originator of the chair concept.

options.explanation: 也很接近，但 originator 更精確突出「最初提出」。
可能後來製作，未必最初構思。

exercises.original: The designer credited with inventing the original visual system was interviewed.
exercises.zh: 被認為最初創立該視覺系統的構思者接受訪問。
exercises.upgrade: The originator of the original visual system was interviewed.

options.explanation: credited with inventing the original 是最直接線索。
可能是其職業，但本句重點是誰首先創立。
強調製作，不是原始構思。

falseSynonyms.zh: 建築師／架構設計者 ≠ 所有 designer architect 可以是 designer 的一種，但需要專業或特定結構設計語境。
插畫師 ≠ 設計師 illustrator 主要創作插畫。 有些 designer 也畫插圖，但角色不同。
藝術總監 ≠ 一般設計師 art director 通常負責整體視覺方向和團隊決策，不一定親自完成設計。
造型師 ≠ 一般設計師 stylist 通常負責搭配、造型或視覺呈現，不等於設計新產品。
開發者 ≠ 設計師 developer 常見於軟件、產品開發，負責實作／建構。 designer 則通常負責設計。
藝術家 ≠ 所有 designer 兩者有重疊，但 artist 的核心是藝術創作，不一定解決功能／使用問題。
詞形陷阱 - design = 名詞／動詞 - designer = 設計者 - designed = 已設計的／被設計
詞形和角色不同 - create = 創造 - creator = 創作者 - creative = 形容詞；也可作名詞指創意人員
